correctness.rationale: Directly reconstructed the n>=4 definition X_n=Theta(C_n)=Ind(C_n)^vee, including empty face and complement convention. Classical cycle independence suspension recurrence locates degrees and free integral ranks. Equivariant Alexander duality multiplies traces by ambient vertex permutation sign. A fixed independent face is a union of eligible symmetry orbits; its signed augmented trace equals minus the independence polynomial of the orbit conflict graph at -1. For rotations these graphs are C_d (including d=1,2 degeneracies) giving 2cos(pi d/3), and for reflections they are paths with lengths (n-1)/2, n/2+1, n/2-2, giving the six-period recurrence. The resulting traces and rational averaging establish every formula and the quotient ring. Independently enumerated oriented noncover chain traces for every dihedral element at n=4..9 using actual source definitions, corroborating the analytic unbounded proof. Code checks alone would not establish the unbounded recurrence.

value.rationale: An infinite-family full dihedral representation and the exact ordinary-quotient ring for a canonical cycle noncover complex fill a natural equivariant refinement of the known cycle homotopy calculation. final_claim: For every n>=4, the ordinary theta/noncover complex of C_n has torsion-free unique-degree reduced homology with rank two at multiples of three and rank one otherwise; its D_n rational character is the inflated standard triangle representation or the indicated reflection sign, and the rational quotient has a sphere cohomology ring precisely for n mod 6 in {1,2}.
